verdict: Purchases rose but revenue per order is falling — we're on it.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered a 4.8 return on ad spend (ROAS) on $1,483.14 in spend, generating $7,120.96 in revenue from 28 purchases. However, in the most recent 7 days ROAS dropped 42% even as purchase count rose 50% — the finding is that customers are buying smaller orders, not that volume is failing. Site traffic has held steady at roughly 230 sessions per day, but purchases have slowed to near-zero in the last three days, pointing to a friction point at checkout that is being investigated and resolved this period. Fresh ad creative is being introduced to address the audience fatigue that is compressing reach, and the subscription page checkout issue is actively being worked through ahead of the funnel test close at end of August.

watch_item.issue: Revenue per order has fallen sharply this week — customers are buying but spending less per transaction, and purchases have slowed to near-zero in the last three days despite steady site traffic.
watch_item.fix: The subscription page checkout flow is being audited for drop-off points, and ad creative is being refreshed this week to counter audience fatigue compressing reach and order intent.
